_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround pa {width}x{height} grid.
Uri player {player_id}. Mihoko inowanzo: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kana w/s/a/d.
Chido: kudzika vose. Mijere inodhura; kukwata mavheti kunokuda; kukwata kwa huviri kunokuda vose.

board.after_moves: Bhodhi pashure pekufamba panguva imwe chete: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Mutambi {player_id} akafa nekuda kwekufamba kusina kukodzera.

outcome.all_crashed: Vatambi vose vakadonha panguva imwe chete.
outcome.turn_limit: Muganhu wokutendeuka wasvika - anorarama kwenguva refu kupfuura vose anokunda.
